instruction: Search for electric vehicles available to buy near 60601, within a 100-mile radius and costing no more than $45,000.

metadata.explanation: Variation 1: Changed to search in different location (ZIP 60601 instead of 10001), with different price cap ($45,000 instead of $50,000), and larger search radius (100 miles instead of 50). Keeps electric fuel type. Uses the same evaluator logic - parsing URL query parameters to verify the search filters. No custom functions needed.
